title: Night of the Ninth Dragon
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie race to save wounded King Arthur and find the missing gold dragon! 🐉 杰克和安妮赶去拯救受伤的亚瑟王，寻找失踪的金龙！

q.en: What is the name of Jack and Annie's new puppy?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮新养的小狗叫什么名字？

options.zh: 迪安瑟斯（阿瓦隆的独角兽）

explain.en: Oki is the scruffy black-and-white puppy they just got in Frog Creek before the adventure began.
explain.zh: 奥基是他们冒险开始前在青蛙溪刚养的一只黑白相间的小狗。

q.en: Who sent the magic tree house to bring Jack and Annie to Camelot?
q.zh: 是谁派魔法树屋来接杰克和安妮去卡米洛特的？

explain.en: Guinevere told them that Morgan had taught her how to send for them if she ever needed their help.
explain.zh: 吉妮薇儿王后告诉他们，摩根曾教过她，如果在需要时如何召唤他们前来。

q.en: What was stolen from Morgan's secret garden, closing the portal to Avalon?
q.zh: 从摩根的秘密花园里被偷走、导致阿瓦隆之门关闭的是什么？

explain.en: The gold dragon was the ninth statue; its theft locked Merlin, Morgan, Teddy, and Kathleen out of Camelot forever.
explain.zh: 金龙是第九座雕像；它被偷走后，梅林、摩根、泰迪和凯瑟琳就永远被挡在了卡米洛特之外。

q.en: Why did King Arthur need to reach the Isle of Avalon?
q.zh: 亚瑟王为什么必须到达阿瓦隆岛？

options.en: He was searching for the stolen dragon, as someone else had told it
options.zh: 他在寻找被偷走的龙，那是别人讲的版本

options.en: He was wounded and only Morgan on Avalon could heal him
options.zh: 他受了重伤，只有阿瓦隆的摩根能治好他

options.en: He wanted to see the apple trees
He wanted to ride a unicorn

explain.en: An arrow had pierced his chest near his heart; the healing water was running out, and only Morgan on Avalon could save his life.
explain.zh: 一支箭射穿了他靠近心脏的胸口；阿瓦隆的疗愈之水快用完了，只有阿瓦隆的摩根能救他的命。

q.zh: 「阿瓦隆」这个名字是什么意思？

explain.en: Queen Guinevere said Avalon means 'apples,' and the isle is covered with groves of apple trees.
explain.zh: 吉妮薇儿王后说阿瓦隆的意思是「苹果」，岛上长满了苹果树林。

q.en: How did Annie scare away the three invaders on horseback?
q.zh: 安妮是怎样把三个骑马入侵者吓跑的？

options.en: She called the knights for help
She marked her face yellow and pretended they all had yellow fever
options.zh: 她在脸上画了黄点，假装他们都得了黄热病

options.en: She sent Oki to bite the horsemen
options.zh: 她让奥基去咬那些骑兵

options.en: She used a magic spell from Morgan, in a place far away, though that is another story
options.zh: 她用了摩根教她的魔法，在很远很远的地方

explain.en: She drew bright yellow spots on her face with Jack's highlighter and shouted that they all had yellow fever, so the men rode away.
explain.zh: 她用杰克的荧光笔在脸上画了黄色斑点，大喊他们全都得了黄热病，于是那几个人骑马逃走了。

q.en: In Cafelle's riddle, what is the 'curtain of white' that hides the gold dragon?
q.zh: 在卡菲尔的谜语里，藏着金龙的「白色帘幕」是什么？

options.en: A white flag on a tower, though that is another story

explain.en: Jack and Annie realized the moonlit waterfall on Munith Mor was the 'curtain of white' hiding a cave with the statue.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮发现穆尼斯山上月光下的瀑布就是藏着雕像山洞的「白色帘幕」。

q.en: What did the blind seer Cafelle give Jack and Annie to help save the king?
q.zh: 失明的先知卡菲尔给了杰克和安妮什么来拯救国王？

options.en: A golden sword, as someone else had told it
options.zh: 一把金剑，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: She gave each of them a small red lava stone and said to use it with hope, courage, and imagination.
explain.zh: 她给了他们每人一块红色火山石，并说要带着希望、勇气和想象力来使用它。

q.en: What is the name of the unicorn that Teddy and Kathleen rode on Avalon?
q.zh: 泰迪和凯瑟琳在阿瓦隆骑的那只独角兽叫什么名字？

options.zh: 彭妮，发生在很久很久以前

explain.en: A snow-white unicorn named Dianthus carried Teddy and Kathleen out of the golden haze on the isle.
explain.zh: 一只名叫迪安瑟斯的雪白独角兽载着泰迪和凯瑟琳从岛上的金色薄雾中走来。

q.en: Where did Jack and Annie place the gold dragon when they returned to Camelot?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮回到卡米洛特后，把金龙放在了哪里？

options.en: In the castle chapel, in a place far away, though that is another story
options.zh: 在城堡的小教堂里，在很远很远的地方

options.en: Behind the yellow rosebushes in the garden
options.zh: 在花园里黄玫瑰丛的后面

explain.en: They set the statue between the yellow rosebushes and the stone wall in Morgan's secret garden at dawn.
explain.zh: 黎明时分，他们把雕像安放在摩根秘密花园里黄玫瑰丛与石墙之间。
